# ---------- the one-tap "Sold out today" switch ----------

def test_sold_out_switch_is_owner_only_audited_and_refuses_a_changed_menu(client, new_client, engine):
    from app.models import AuditEvent

    biz = shop(client)
    url = f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/sold-out"
    name = biz["profile"]["products"][1]["name"]
    r = client.put(url, json={"index": 1, "name": name, "sold_out": True})
    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["profile"]["products"][1]["sold_out"] is True
    assert "Sold out today" in client.get("/", headers=HOST).text
    assert client.put(url, json={"index": 1, "name": "Something else", "sold_out": False}).status_code == 409
    assert client.put(url, json={"index": 99, "name": name, "sold_out": False}).status_code == 409
    assert new_client().put(url, json={"index": 1, "name": name, "sold_out": False}).status_code in (401, 403, 404)
    r = client.put(url, json={"index": 1, "name": name, "sold_out": False})
    assert r.json()["profile"]["products"][1]["sold_out"] is False
    with Session(engine) as s:
        rows = [e.detail for e in s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "item_sold_out")).all()]
    assert rows == ["item 2: sold out today", "item 2: back on sale"]

    from app.models import Business

    biz = shop(client)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        b = s.get(Business, biz["id"])
        pending = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
        pending.tagline = "Edited and waiting"
        b.pending_profile_json = pending.model_dump_json()
        s.add(b)
        s.commit()
    name = biz["profile"]["products"][2]["name"]
    r = client.put(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/sold-out", json={"index": 2, "name": name, "sold_out": True})

        b = s.get(Business, biz["id"])
        assert Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json).products[2].sold_out

        assert Profile.model_validate_json(b.pending_profile_json).tagline == "Edited and waiting"
EOF

import re
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

from app.models import AuditEvent, Business, Order
from app.sites import demo, motifs, themes

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NAMES = list(demo.DEMOS)


def raw(name: str) -> dict:
    return json.loads((demo.FIXTURES / f"{demo.DEMOS[name]}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def test_every_look_has_a_demo_and_every_demo_its_own_motif():
    assert 6 <= len(NAMES) <= 8
    looks = {themes.resolve(demo.demo_shop(n))[0].key for n in NAMES}
    assert looks == set(themes.THEME_KEYS)
    sigs = [motifs.signature(themes.resolve(demo.demo_shop(n))[0].key, demo.demo_shop(n).name, demo.demo_shop(n).motif,
                             demo.demo_shop(n).art)[0] for n in NAMES]
    assert len(set(sigs)) == len(sigs), sigs
    for n, (motif, art) in demo.DEMO_SIGNATURES.items():  # explicit keys are real keys of that demo's own look
        theme = demo.DEMO_LOOKS[n][0]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", NAMES)
def test_every_demo_renders_labelled_noindex_with_no_contact_or_upi(client, name):

    assert "upi://" not in html and 'id="pay"' not in html and "wa.me" not in html and 'href="tel:' not in html
    assert "instagram.com" not in html and "Kind words" not in html
    sample = raw(name)
    for key in ("upi_id", "phone", "whatsapp", "instagram"):
        value = str(sample.get(key) or "").strip()
        if value:

    assert "Demo shop" in r.text or "This is a demo" in r.text
    with Session(engine) as s:

    assert len(getattr(mailer, "sent", [])) == before

# ---------- the landing strip ----------

STRIP = ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "landing" / "demoShops.ts"

            for m in re.findall(r'\{ slug: "([a-z]+)", name: "([^"]+)", look: "([^"]+)", thumb: "([^"]+)" \}', text)]

        assert thumb.exists() and thumb.stat().st_size <= 60 * 1024, e["thumb"]

"""S17: LaunchWitness's own icons are real files on the app's host, never on a shop, and the backend's own HTML links them."""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import BRAND_FILES, create_app
from tests.test_s11d_chain import launched, share_path

ICON = b"\x00\x00\x01\x00fake-ico"


def _app_with_icons(tmp_path, client):
    for name in BRAND_FILES:
        (tmp_path / name).write_bytes(ICON if name.endswith(".ico") else b"x")
    (tmp_path / "index.html").write_text("<html>spa</html>")
    app = create_app(frontend_dist=tmp_path, replay_page=tmp_path / "none.html", run_lifespan=False)
    app.dependency_overrides.update(client.app.dependency_overrides)
    return app


def test_icons_are_files_with_their_types(tmp_path, client):
    with TestClient(_app_with_icons(tmp_path, client)) as c:
        r = c.get("/favicon.ico")
        assert r.status_code == 200 and r.headers["content-type"] == "image/x-icon" and r.content == ICON
        assert c.get("/apple-touch-icon.png").headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
        assert c.get("/site.webmanifest").headers["content-type"].startswith("application/manifest+json")

"""Make ONE live Claude call per target and save the reply as a fixture.

Targets:
  reader:<seller_id>   sample sellers (tests/fixtures/sellers) and hard cases (tests/fixtures/sellers_hard)
  namer:<seller_id>    uses that seller's saved reader fixture as the profile
  doctor:<check>       a realistic failure of that launch check (doctor:all = every check)

Money rules (session 6): one call per target, never a retry; the run STOPS at
the first failed target so a broken prompt can't burn credit. Every reply is
also written to replay/raw/claude/<fixture>.json (git-ignored) so a bad reply
can be debugged offline instead of paying for another call. All calls go
through LiveClaudeClient (max_tokens, daily cap, ClaudeUsage rows).

Usage (CLAUDE_MODE=live and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment):
    cd backend && ../.venv/bin/python ../scripts/capture_live_fixtures.py reader:meera_cakes namer:meera_cakes
    (Windows venv: use ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe instead of ../.venv/bin/python)
    ... --dry-run <targets>   worst-case cost per target, no key needed, no call made
    ... --report              today's live spend from the ClaudeUsage table, per fixture

S14 (shop themes): the Reader now also picks a theme, an accent and three short lines of page copy. The saved Reader
replies carry hand-written values for these (marked `_note` + `_theme_placeholder`). To replace them with live ones
WITHOUT touching the rest of the saved replies (prices, categories and everything the other tests pin):

    cd backend && CLAUDE_MODE=live ../.venv/bin/python ../scripts/capture_live_fixtures.py --theme-only reader:themes
    (reader:themes = six sellers, reader:themes-all = all 12; or name some: --theme-only reader:meera_cakes reader:tailor)
    ... --theme-only --dry-run reader:themes     worst-case cost first, no key needed

S15 (food marks): the same --theme-only re-capture ALSO replaces the hand-written `allergens` and per-item `food_mark` values
(the Reader now suggests them; the seller confirms on Review). Nothing extra to run, same cost (cap <= $0.10 for the six).

One live Reader call per seller (strong model), stops at the first failure, daily cap applies (set it to <= $0.10).
Only `theme`, `accent` and `section_copy` are copied into the saved file; `_note` / `_theme_placeholder` are removed.
"""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))
def main(args: list[str]) -> int:
    settings = get_settings()
    if args == ["--report"]:
        return report()
    dry = "--dry-run" in args
    theme_only = "--theme-only" in args
    targets = [a for a in args if a not in ("--dry-run", "--theme-only")]
    if theme_only:
        targets = [t for x in targets for t in ([f"reader:{s}" for s in THEME_SELLERS] if x == "reader:themes" else
                                    [f"reader:{s}" for s in THEME_SELLERS_ALL] if x == "reader:themes-all" else [x])]
        if any(not t.startswith("reader:") for t in targets):
            print("--theme-only works on reader targets only.")
            return 2
    if not dry and settings.claude_mode != "live":
        print("Set CLAUDE_MODE=live to run this.")
        return 2
    targets = [t for x in targets for t in ([f"doctor:{c}" for c in DOCTOR_CASES] if x == "doctor:all" else [x])]
    if not targets or len(targets) > MAX_CALLS:
        print(f"Give 1..{MAX_CALLS} targets.")
        return 2
    plans = [(t, *request_for(t)) for t in targets]  # fail on typos before spending anything
    if dry:
        return dry_run(plans, settings)
    engine = get_engine()
    init_db(engine)
    client = LiveClaudeClient(settings, engine)
    RAW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        before = spent_today_usd(s)
    status = 0
    for target, fixture, kw, validate in plans:
        client.last_raw = None
        try:
            data = client.ask_json(fixture=fixture, **kw)
            validate(data)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"{target}: NOT saved ({type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:300]}). Stopping: no more calls this run.")
            status = 1
        else:
            path = FIXTURE_DIR / f"{fixture}.json"
            if theme_only:  # keep the saved live reply; take over only the S14 fields (and drop the placeholder marks)
                saved = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                saved.update({k: data[k] for k in THEME_KEYS_ONLY})
                # S15: the same call also gives `allergens` and each item's `food_mark` (matched by item name)
                saved["allergens"] = data.get("allergens", "")
                marks = {x["name"]: x.get("food_mark", "") for x in data.get("products", [])}
                for x in saved.get("products", []):
                    x["food_mark"] = marks.get(x["name"], x.get("food_mark", ""))
                saved.pop("_note", None)
                saved.pop("_theme_placeholder", None)
                saved.pop("_food_placeholder", None)
                data = saved
            path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"{target}: saved {fixture}.json" + (" (theme fields only)" if theme_only else ""))
        if client.last_raw:
            (RAW_DIR / f"{fixture}.json").write_text(json.dumps(client.last_raw, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                                                     encoding="utf-8")
            r = client.last_raw
            print(f"   {r['model']} in={r['input_tokens']} out={r['output_tokens']} ${r['cost_usd']:.4f} stop={r['stop_reason']}")
        if status:
            break
    with Session(engine) as s:
        after = spent_today_usd(s)
    print(f"Spend this run: ${after - before:.4f} · today total: ${after:.4f} (cap ${settings.claude_daily_spend_cap_usd:.2f})")
    return status


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

# S21 — items sold the way the seller sells them, link previews, "Share my shop", and the demo-shop strip

Session 21, cloud, unattended, branch `s21-adaptive-items` (from `origin/main` = `55109b2`, which already holds all of
20B: status-token hash, first-name-only status page, privacy clause, pay-on-delivery test, favicon 204, motif strip).
**Not merged, not deployed.** The laptop session updates PROGRESS / STATE / README.

The idea: Claude (the Reader) may say HOW each item is sold; code validates every key and draws it. Claude never writes
HTML/CSS/JS. Unchanged: escaping, the strict CSP with hashed fixed scripts (still exactly two: `fx.js` and the basket
script), the works-without-JS order form, the idempotency token, the `lw-shop` marker, private UPI, `live_contact`.

## Audit: how items were handled before S21

| Where | Before | S21 |
|---|---|---|
| `Product` (`agents/reader.py`) | name, one `price_inr`, description, category, addon, price_from, food_mark, new_until | + `options`, `option_kind`, `unit`, `min_qty`, `max_qty`, `choice_label` + `choices`, `notice_days`, `sold_out` (all optional; old profiles load unchanged) |
| Order form fields | one `qty_<i>` per item, max 50 | `qty_<i>` for a plain item; `qty_<i>_<j>` per option; `choice_<i>` select |
| `orders.parse_order_form` | sum of `qty_<i>` × `price_inr` | `order_lines()`: option prices only from the menu, min/max per item (all options together), sold out refused, choice required and from her list, unknown option box refused, item notice on the date |
| Totals / capacity | `ful.items_total`, orders-per-day count | unchanged (lines still `{qty, price_inr}`); capacity still counts orders, not lines |
| Basket script (`seller.html`) | one input per `.item` row | one `.q` unit per box; Add puts in the item's minimum; the choice select shows (and is required) once the item has a quantity |
| `fx.js` quick view | one stepper driving the row | one chip + stepper per option, a mirror of the choice select; sold-out items have no stepper |
| Orders page, order email, thank-you, status page, WhatsApp "send this order" | `qty × name` | `qty × name · option · choice` (`items.line_label`) |
| Checker's test order | first non-extra item, `qty_<i>=1` | `checker.lines_for_test_order`: first non-extra, non-sold-out item, its first option, its minimum, its first choice; no date (like the shop notice). Every item sold out: a note-only test order (the form accepts it) |
| `photos.follow_items` | renamed item keeps photo only if the list kept its length | + a size merged into one item with sizes moves its photo there (`photos.merged_into`) |
| New badge (`newness.py`) | per item | unchanged |
| Review item editor | name, price, group, description, extra, food mark, photo, from-price, New | + "Sizes, minimum, choices" (`ItemSelling.tsx`) and "Sold out today" |
| Policy text (`policy.shop_text`) | item name + description | + option labels and choices (they are words); identical text for items without them |

## What shipped

**STEP 1 (data model, server side)** — `app/sites/items.py` (wording, caps, `split_size`, `group_sizes`, `notes`),
validators in `reader.Product` (plain text, lengths, prices > 0, ≤ 8 options / choices, unique labels, unknown keys
dropped, bad values → defaults, `price_inr` = lowest option), `orders.order_lines`, checker test lines, photos follow
merges, `tidy_profile` groups sizes (Meera: "Chocolate truffle cake" with ½ kg ₹650 / 1 kg ₹1,200), demos get the same
grouping. Tests: `tests/test_s21_items.py`.

**STEP 2 (Reader)** — schema + prompt: options / option_kind / unit / min_qty / max_qty / choice_label + choices /
notice_days, only from her words; `sold_out` is never asked. Hand-written placeholders (see below) + new hard seller
`crochet`.

**STEP 3 (draw it, owner tools)** — option rows with their own steppers in all six looks (`css/items.css`, included
after the menu layout), "from ₹X", "per piece", "Min 5", "Max N", "Order N days ahead", "Sold out today" (no box,
photo greyed, name struck through, the words stay full contrast), quick-view chips. Review: `ItemSelling.tsx`.
`PUT /api/businesses/{id}/sold-out` (owner; item named by place AND name; audited `item_sold_out`; no policy check;
also applied to a held edit) behind "Sold out today" lists on the Orders page and each live shop's My shops card.

**STEP 4** — Open Graph + Twitter tags + canonical on a live shop's home page only (`render.share_view`,
`hosts.shop_url`: built from the stored shop, never the Host header). "Share on WhatsApp" + "Print a poster"
(`GET /api/businesses/{id}/poster`, owner only, 404 unless live, segno QR, no script, strict CSP, print CSS).

**STEP 5 (own commits, mergeable alone)** — eight demo shops (`/demo/meera|imran|sunita|sugarcrumb|zari|ember|giftgarden|greencorner`,
every look covered, every motif different), `/demos/<slug>.webp` served on the app host only, the landing strip
(`landing/DemoStrip.tsx`, `demoShops.ts`, `demo-strip.css`) between "How the proof works" and "We keep watching",
`scripts/make_demo_thumbs.js`, thumbnails in `frontend/public/demos/` (21–35 KB each).

## Decisions (unattended)

1. **Order lines keep `option_label` / `choice` only when the item has them** (older readers of `items_json` see the same
   three keys for plain items). Every reader uses `.get()` / `items.line_label`.
2. **A `qty_<i>` box for an item that now has options, or an option index that doesn't exist, is refused** with a plain
   message when it carries a quantity; a stale box with 0 is ignored. A box for an item index that no longer exists is
   still ignored, as before S21.
3. **Min / max count all of an item's options together**; the one choice applies to the whole item (all its sizes).
4. **Item notice** applies only when it is longer than the shop's `min_notice_days`; an order with such an item needs a
   date ("X needs 7 days' notice. Please pick the date…"). The date box appears when any orderable item has such notice.
5. **`unit` wording is fixed** ("per piece", "per kg", "per gram"…): "₹40 per rose" would need free text, so a rose is
   "per piece". `option_kind` "" reads "Options".
6. **Sold out with every item**: the page has no quantity box, so `proof.find_order_form` now returns the order form even
   without boxes; the checker still demands the boxes its own test order uses whenever any item can be ordered.
7. **Grouping is conservative**: same base name AND category, ≥ 2 members, no extras, no "from" prices, same food mark,
   distinct labels. On the gallery it merges only Meera's truffle cake (bakery) and the messy-WhatsApp mango achaar.
   It runs on Reader replies and demos, never on an owner's saved menu (live shops don't change until re-read).
8. **Page budget**: a small shop's raw HTML budget went 75 → 85 KB (the option rows' CSS and script, +1.4 KB gzipped) and
   a gzipped budget was added (≤ 20 KB small shop, ≤ 22 KB big menu), which is what travels (`test_s14_themes`).
9. **The strip drifts by moving the row's scroll position** (composited scroll, no layout/paint of the cards), not a CSS
   transform, so swipe / scroll-snap / arrows / Tab all work on the same element; snap is switched off only while drifting.
   The looping copy is `aria-hidden` and not focusable; reduced motion renders no copy and never moves.
10. **Demo pages also drop the sample's Instagram handle and pasted customer messages** (`demo.demo_shop`), and new demos
    get explicit motifs so all eight differ; the three older demos look exactly as before.
11. **Share text** is "Order from <shop>: <url>" (wa.me with no number: she picks the chat). The poster uses the theme's
    AA-tested accent pair.
12. Not built: a "choice" per option (one choice per item only), images per option, inventory counts (out of scope).

## Reader fixtures that are hand-written placeholders (re-capture on the laptop)

- `reader_meera_cakes.json`, `reader_tiffin_service.json`, `reader_prompt_injection.json`: only the per-item S21 fields
  (and Meera's truffle cake written as one item with two options) are hand-written; marked `_note` "S21 placeholder,
  re-capture on the laptop" + `_s21_placeholder` (quality gates keep running on the live rest, like S14's theme fields).
- `reader_crochet.json`: **the whole reply** is hand-written (new seller `tests/fixtures/sellers_hard/crochet.json`).

Re-capture (owner's laptop, key in env, cap ≤ $0.25; dry-run first; four strong-model calls, one each, stops at the first failure):

```bash
cd backend
../.venv/Scripts/python ../scripts/capture_live_fixtures.py --dry-run reader:meera_cakes reader:tiffin_service reader:prompt_injection reader:crochet
CLAUDE_MODE=live CLAUDE_DAILY_SPEND_CAP_USD=0.25 ../.venv/Scripts/python ../scripts/capture_live_fixtures.py reader:meera_cakes reader:tiffin_service reader:prompt_injection reader:crochet
../.venv/Scripts/python -m pytest -q tests/test_s21_items.py tests/test_s6_agents.py tests/test_reader.py
```

This replaces the whole saved reply (not `--theme-only`), so read the diff before committing: the S21 placeholder
test (`test_s21_placeholders_are_marked_for_the_laptop_recapture`) will then fail on purpose — delete it — and any
test pinned to an exact Meera / tiffin item name or price may need its new value. Then `REQUIRE_LIVE_FIXTURES=1 pytest -q tests/test_s6_agents.py`.

## Numbers (this sandbox)

- Backend `pytest -n 4 --ignore tests/test_s13_scale.py`: see the PR for the final count. One failure every run tonight,
  `test_s13_outbox.py::test_held_mail_goes_out_the_next_day`: it fails the same on unchanged `origin/main` at this hour
  (it depends on the clock near the IST day boundary), not caused by S21.
- ruff clean, `tsc` clean, `npm run build` clean.
- e2e on the dev server (bundled Chromium 1243 via `LW_CHROME`): new `r-s21.spec.ts` 5/5; full suite: see the PR.
  Docker not run here (no Docker in this sandbox): the laptop runs the Docker stack + `check_m1.sh --local`.
- STEP 5 alone: its two commits cherry-pick cleanly onto `origin/main`; there backend tests pass (same one clock failure),
  `tsc` and the build pass.
- Screenshots: `docs/screenshots/s21/` (Meera item row + quick view, crochet menu, Review options editor, landing strip;
  390 and 1440, 2x).

input.head: s21-adaptive-items
input.title: S21: items sold by size/pack/min/choice, Sold out today, link previews, Share my shop, demo-shop strip
input.body:
**Do not merge from the cloud. Not deployed.** The owner merges on the laptop. Full write-up, audit and decisions: `docs/S21.md`.

Branched from `origin/main` = `55109b2`. All of 20B is already on main (status-token hash, first-name-only status page, privacy clause, pay-on-delivery test, favicon 204, motif strip). Nothing from 20B is redone or undone here.

## What shipped
- **STEP 1 (data model, server side).** `Product` gets these optional fields: `options` (≤8, each with its own price), `option_kind`, `unit`, `min_qty`, `max_qty`, `choice_label` + `choices`, `notice_days`, `sold_out`. Old profiles load unchanged, and bad values fall back to the defaults.
  - Order form: `qty_<i>_<j>` per option (works without JS) and `choice_<i>`.
  - `orders.order_lines` takes prices only from the menu. It enforces min/max per item, refuses sold-out items, requires a choice from her own list, refuses an option box that isn't on the menu, and checks item notice against the date.
  - Order lines show as "name · option · choice" on the thank-you page, the email, the WhatsApp line and the Orders page.
  - `tidy_profile` merges sizes into one item, e.g. Meera's "Chocolate truffle cake" with ½ kg ₹650 / 1 kg ₹1,200.
  - Photos follow merged items.
  - The checker's test order picks the first item that isn't sold out, its first option, its minimum quantity and its first choice. It passes in every selling mode, including when every item is sold out.
- **STEP 3 (drawing it, owner tools).** All six looks show option rows with their own steppers, "from ₹X", "per piece", "Min 5", "Order N days ahead", "Sold out today" (no quantity box), and quick-view chips with the choice.
  - Review gets an "Sizes, minimum, choices" editor per item.
  - New owner route `PUT /api/businesses/{id}/sold-out` for one-tap "Sold out today" on the Orders page and the My shops card. It skips the policy check because no words change. Option labels and choices do count as words and go through the policy check on live shops.
- **STEP 4.**
  - Open Graph, Twitter and canonical tags, only on a live shop's home page.
  - "Share on WhatsApp" link and "Print a poster" (owner-only page with a QR code, no script, strict CSP).
- **STEP 5 (its own commits, can be merged alone).**
  - Eight demo shops; every look has at least one and every motif is different.
  - Landing strip "See shops made with LaunchWitness" between the proof and watching sections.
  - `scripts/make_demo_thumbs.js` and WebP thumbnails of 21–35 KB each.
- **STEP 2.** The Reader's schema and prompt now cover these fields, only from the seller's own words; `sold_out` is never asked. Saved replies are hand-written placeholders (listed below).

## STEP 5 only (merge alone if needed)
`8be20e3`, `3e2d160`, `2d4685e`. I checked: they cherry-pick cleanly onto `origin/main`, and on that tree the backend tests, `tsc` and the build all pass.

## Decisions (details in docs/S21.md)
1. Order lines carry option and choice keys only when the item has them.
2. A box with a quantity for an option or item that isn't on the menu is refused; empty or 0 boxes are ignored.
3. Min/max count all of an item's options together. There is one choice per item.
4. Item notice applies only when it's longer than the shop's own notice, and then a date is required.
5. Unit wording is fixed, so a rose shows as "₹40 per piece", not "per rose".
6. `find_order_form` also accepts a form with no quantity boxes (all items sold out). The checker still requires its own boxes whenever an item can be ordered.
7. Grouping is conservative: same name and category, no extras, no "from" prices, same food mark. It only runs on Reader replies and demos, never on a menu the owner saved.
8. Small-shop raw HTML budget raised from 75 to 85 KB, and a new gzip budget added (≤20/22 KB). The real growth is +1.4 KB gzipped.
9. The strip drifts by moving the row's scroll position (composited), so swipe, snap, arrows and Tab all work. With reduced motion it doesn't move and there's no looping copy.
10. Demo pages also hide the sample's Instagram handle and pasted customer messages.

## Open item for the owner
Every item now carries 8 more keys (about 35 output tokens each), against `CLAUDE_MAX_TOKENS=1500`. A long menu (roughly 15+ items) could hit the limit, so a live reading might get cut off. I didn't change this; it's your budget call. Options are in docs/S21.md.

## Placeholders to re-capture on the laptop (STEP 2)
- `reader_meera_cakes`, `reader_tiffin_service`, `reader_prompt_injection`: only the S21 item fields are hand-written. They're marked `_note` "S21 placeholder, re-capture on the laptop" + `_s21_placeholder`.
- `reader_crochet` (new seller `sellers_hard/crochet.json`): the whole reply is hand-written.
- Command (dry-run first, cap $0.25, worst case $0.08) is in docs/S21.md.

## Tests
- Backend: **1675 passed, 2 skipped**, `test_s13_scale` excluded (baseline 1575 + 2). New: `test_s21_items.py` (77), `test_s21_demos.py` (20), plus landing-copy pins.
  - `test_s13_outbox.py::test_held_mail_goes_out_the_next_day` failed for about an hour tonight on unchanged main too. It depends on the clock near the IST day boundary and passes in the final run.
- ruff, `tsc` and build are clean. Secret scan is clean.
- e2e on the dev server: full suite **41 passed, 1 skipped** (the Docker-only Mailpit flow). New `r-s21.spec.ts` passes 5/5.
  - One S20 e2e test was updated: `q-s20` now fills `qty_0_0`, because item 0 has sizes.
  - **Not run here (no Docker):** the Docker stack and `check_m1.sh --local`.
- Hero scroll trace, A/B against main in this sandbox: idle 0.8% vs 0.7% at 1440 px, 3.0–3.2% vs 2.4–3.2% at 390 px with 4× CPU throttle. Frames and CLS are unchanged. The first strip version had a regression here, which is fixed in `2d4685e`.

## Screenshots
`docs/screenshots/s21/`: Meera item row + quick view, crochet menu, Review options editor, landing strip (390 and 1440), `hero-trace.txt`.

## Diff
76 files changed, 2705 insertions(+), 160 deletions(-) (before the docs/transcript commits).
